subject: Recap: Security deliverables + proposed timeline for SOC 2 package
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Lin <sophia.lin@acmefin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Recap: Security deliverables + proposed timeline for SOC 2 package

Hi Sophia —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposed set of security milestones so we can align on owners and dates. I dropped a one-page MAP draft as an attachment (initial_map_draft.md) — please treat this as a working doc.

High level: we scoped a dedicated security intake so your compliance team can validate Redwood's SOC 2 posture and collect the evidence you need for your internal approval. Proposed milestones:

- Milestone A — Questionnaire answers from Acme: due 2027-06-15 (owner: Acme security)
- Milestone B — Redwood assembles SOC 2 evidence bundle (policies, artifact list, audit logs export): due 2027-06-23 (owner: Redwood Security)
- Milestone C — Joint security review call and Q&A: target week of 2027-06-28, ideally completed by 2027-06-30
- Milestone D — Optional: sample pen-test / supplement deliverable: TBD (owner: Acme / third-party)

Key dependencies / asks for your team:
- Answers to the attached questionnaire (security_questions_v1.pdf) or a copy pasted reply so we can map gaps
- Short-lived read-only access for exporting audit logs (S3/CloudTrail) — Redwood will provide IAM role instructions
- Signed NNDA before we exchange redacted logs or PII-bearing artifacts

Questions for you: if Acme can move the questionnaire to 06/15 (one day earlier than our call suggested) that helps us hit the evidence assembly date of 06/23. Also confirm who on your side will be the technical contact for access (name + email).

I’ll follow up with a revised MAP once I hear back.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: initial_map_draft.md (MAP skeleton, milestones table)

From: Sophia Lin <sophia.lin@acmefin.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Derek Cheng <derek.cheng@acmefin.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Security deliverables + proposed timeline for SOC 2 package

Hi Nikhil —

Thanks for the clear recap. Derek (cc'd) is our security manager and will own the questionnaire. A few quick items:

- We can aim to return the questionnaire by 2027-06-15, but would prefer 2027-06-14 if possible (we have a slot on the 15th booked for another audit).
- For audit logs: can you confirm whether Redwood provides an export of CloudTrail events or whether we need to pull logs from our side and send to you? We need that clarified for our internal runbook.
- We will need the NNDA signed before sending any logs. I'll attach our standard NNDA in my next email.

I've attached our security_questions_v1.pdf with a couple of inline notes where we need examples from you (session retention, KV cache handling).

Sophia Lin
Director, Information Security 
Acme Financial
sophia.lin@acmefin.com

Attachment: security_questions_v1.pdf

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Lin <sophia.lin@acmefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 11:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap: Security deliverables + proposed timeline for SOC 2 package

Sophia / Derek —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Per your ask, attached is MAP_v2.docx (updated timeline) and an evidence_manifest_template.xlsx to make the handoff simpler. Summary of updates below and owners assigned:

- Questionnaire due: 2027-06-14 (owner: Acme - Derek)
- Redwood to provide initial SOC 2 evidence bundle: 2027-06-21 (soft) / 2027-06-23 (firm) (owner: Redwood Security - Marissa)
- Joint review call: 2027-06-29 (owner: Redwood / Acme)
- Target commercial close: 2027-07-14 (owner: Sales / Acme procurement)

Owners & responsibilities (high level):
- Acme: complete questionnaire; provide access requested in the manifest; confirm retention window requirements
- Redwood: compile policies, control narratives, sample config screenshots, exportable audit logs, and a redacted evidence bundle for review
- Legal/Procurement: parallel approval — Redwood to provide standard SOW/NNDA templates via DocuSign

Dependencies we still need resolved before evidence export:
1) Signed NNDA (Sophia noted) — we will route via DocuSign link
2) Short-lived S3/CloudTrail read-only role (we will send instructions)
3) Confirmation of any required data redaction fields (PII, account IDs)

Marissa — can you confirm RDW can produce CloudTrail exports and a CSV of access events by 2027-06-23? Also, if there's any evidence that is time-consuming to produce (e.g., nightly backups or long-term retention buckets) flag that now so we can set expectations.

Attaching: MAP_v2.docx, evidence_manifest_template.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot deal with the dates (link below).

Nikhil

Attachments: MAP_v2.docx; evidence_manifest_template.xlsx
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DP-487

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophia Lin <sophia.lin@acmefin.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Recap: Security deliverables + proposed timeline for SOC 2 package

Hi team —

Quick security check and a couple confirmations from our side:

- We can provide CloudTrail and application access logs export (redacted) and an events CSV by 2027-06-23, scoped to the last 90 days.
- Short-lived read-only S3 role works for us; I'll circulate the exact IAM policy and steps. We will only request the minimal permissions necessary (GetObject, ListBucket, CloudTrail Read).
- NNDA: Redwood requests a countersigned NNDA before full log exchange. If Acme can upload the signed NNDA (or complete DocuSign), we can proceed with the export prep.
- Evidence that might require more time: long-term backups and on-prem connector logs (if you use self-hosted agents) — call those out in the manifest.

Action items assigned:
- Marissa: provide IAM policy + export runbook by 2027-06-15; confirm list of artifacts that will be in the bundle
- Nikhil: update MAP and confirm joint review meeting time
- Sophia / Derek: return questionnaire and NNDA

I'll attach our access instructions for Acme's infra team.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_access_instructions.pdf

From: Sophia Lin <sophia.lin@acmefin.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Derek Cheng <derek.cheng@acmefin.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 18:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Security deliverables + proposed timeline for SOC 2 package

Thanks, all. Confirming the plan below and a couple of updates from Acme:

- We will return the completed questionnaire by EOD 2027-06-14 (Derek will send).
- We uploaded the countersigned NNDA to your DocuSign link and attached signed_nnda.pdf for your records.
- Evidence bundle: Acme will push required logs and requested artifacts by 2027-06-23. We will include a pen-test report (optional) — if Redwood can accept that as a post-delivery supplement, that would be helpful.
- We agree to the target commercial close of 2027-07-14 and will have procurement engaged by the end of June.

Last ask: can Redwood add a short table in the MAP that shows which items require NNDA and which we can share without it? That will help speed internal approvals.

Appreciate the fast coordination — Derek will reach out with the questionnaire answers tomorrow.

Best,
Sophia Lin
Director, Information Security, Acme Financial
sophia.lin@acmefin.com

Attachment: signed_nnda.pdf
